title: Databricks Runtime 19: October 5, 2026
body:
### New features and improvements

* **Kinesis polling in real-time mode is generally available on classic compute**: In Databricks Runtime 19 and above, Amazon Kinesis polling with real-time mode is generally available for Structured Streaming on classic compute. See [Set up real-time mode](/aws/en/structured-streaming/real-time/setup), [Connect to Amazon Kinesis](/aws/en/connect/streaming/kinesis), and the [Kinesis source to Kafka sink example](/aws/en/structured-streaming/real-time/examples#kinesis-source-to-kafka-sink).
